title: Total Remaining equals Not Started plus Started — Remaining
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The report shows jobs in the "Approved - not started" and "Approved - partially completed" tabs with non-zero remaining values.
custom_steps:
1. Add the Not Started figure to the Started — Remaining figure.
2. Compare the sum to Total Remaining.
custom_expected: 1. Total Remaining equals Not Started plus Started — Remaining, to the cent.
